rows.name: id
rows.description:
Row ID
Row number, unique. Equals the __rowid__ column data-table's loaders add.
constraints: When point.tier = "it's" (Row 4: text that needs escaping), value = 4.

rows.name: label
rows.description:
Row label
The showcase row's name in rows 1-11, a random two-word label in rows 12-999; null in row 0.
constraints: When id < 12, value matches ^showcase: or value is null.
When shifty is an integer or true or false, value is a string.
shifty is an integer or true or false

rows.name: counts
rows.description:
Counts
Up to four integers below 1,000. Row 3 holds integers past 2^53, which a JavaScript number rounds; rows 5-7 hold 1,000, 2,500 and 10,000 digits.
constraints: When id ≥ 12, (value has at most 4 items and value has only items where (item ≤ 999 or item is null)) or value is null.

rows.name: signed
rows.description:
Signed integers
Up to three integers from -99 to 99; the INT64 limits in row 3. Mixed signs make DuckDB read HUGEINT[] rather than BIGINT[].
constraints: When id ≥ 12, (value has at most 3 items and value has only items where -99 ≤ item ≤ 99) or value is null.

rows.name: huge
rows.description:
Huge integers
One or two integers below 1,000; 2^63 and the UINT64 maximum in row 3, past INT64, so DuckDB reads HUGEINT[].

rows.name: floats
rows.description:
Floats
Up to three numbers with three decimals; -0.0, 5e-324, ±the largest double and 2^64 in row 3.

rows.name: words
rows.description:
Words
One or two lorem-ipsum words. Row 4 holds 15 strings that need escaping; row 8 a 20,000-character string with an emoji across data-table's display cap.
constraints: When id ≥ 12, value has at most 2 items or value is null.
When point.tier = "platinum" or point is null, value has at most 2 items or value is null.
When people has only items where (people[].langs has no items or people[].langs is null or people[].langs is absent) or people is null, value has at most 2 items or value is null.
people has only items where (people[].langs has no items or people[].langs is null or people[].langs is absent) or people is null

rows.name: ids
rows.description:
IDs
One random version-4 UUID; the nil and all-ones UUIDs in row 9.
constraints: When ids has at least 2 items, value has no repeated items.

rows.name: empty_list
rows.description:
Empty list
[] in every row that is not null. With no element to go by, DuckDB types the elements JSON.

rows.name: mixed_list
rows.description:
Mixed list
Up to three elements of mixed JSON types. DuckDB keeps each as JSON; a null element is SQL NULL.
rows.type: array of (number or string or boolean or object or array of integer or null) (nullable)

rows.name: mixed_list[]
rows.type: number or string or boolean or object or array of integer (nullable)

rows.name: mixed_list[].k
rows.description: Digit
constraints: Required when mixed_list[] is an object

rows.name: people
rows.description:
People
One person, sometimes two. Row 2 holds a null person and one whose fields are all null.
constraints: When id ≥ 12, (value has at most 2 items and value has only items where item is an object) or value is null.
When people has at least 2 items where people[].age ≥ 70, value has at most 2 items.
people has at least 2 items where people[].age ≥ 70

additional.x-duckdb-type: STRUCT("name" VARCHAR, age BIGINT, langs VARCHAR[])[]

rows.name: people[].name
rows.description:
First name
From a pool of 16 computing pioneers.
constraints: When id ≥ 12, value is a string or absent.

rows.name: people[].age
rows.description: Age (years)
constraints: When id ≥ 12, value is an integer or absent.
When people[].name = null in the same item, value = null.
people[].name = null in the same item

rows.name: people[].langs
rows.description:
Languages
ISO 639-1 codes, usually none or one.
constraints: When people[].name = null in the same item, value = null.
people[].name = null in the same item

rows.name: matrix
rows.description:
Matrix
One or two rows of up to three digits. Row 2 holds [[1, null], null, []].
rows.type: array of nullable array of nullable integer (nullable)
constraints: Each item: When value has at least 3 items, value has only items where item is an integer.

rows.name: matrix[]
constraints: When value has at least 3 items, value has only items where item is an integer.

rows.name: point
rows.description:
Point
A point and its tier, like the struct columns of data-table's wide test file. {} in row 1.

additional.x-duckdb-type: STRUCT(x DOUBLE, y DOUBLE, tier VARCHAR)

rows.name: point.x
rows.description:
x coordinate
Standard normal, two decimals.
constraints: When id ≥ 12, value must be present if point is an object (may be null).

rows.name: point.y
rows.description:
y coordinate
Standard normal, two decimals.
constraints: When id ≥ 12, value must be present if point is an object (may be null).

rows.name: point.tier
rows.description:
Tier
From bronze (lowest) to platinum (highest).
constraints: When id ≥ 12, value is one of "bronze", "silver", "gold", "platinum" (required if point is an object).
When point.tier is present, point.x and point.y are also required.
